where: display after 'Soit Z(X,G,t) la série formelle': Z(X,G,t) = prod det(1-F_x t^deg(x) ; G_x)^-1 ∈ F[[t]] .
scan: ∈ F[[t]] : a clean typed F (foot serif centred on the stem, no bottom arm; pixel check)
note: E is the coefficient field (5.0; G is an E-faisceau) and F the geometric Frobenius, so the series lies in E[[t]]. The TeX keeps the printed F.

where: Théorème 5.2.2, last line: 'F et q^{n-i} F de H^i_c (X,G) sont T-entiers'
note: The statement has no other underlined word; everywhere else in § 5 the cohomology over F_q is the underlined H (5.2.3 and the proof on this page, p. 385). The underline meant for H appears to have gone under the preceding 'de'. The TeX keeps the printed reading.

where: 'On sait, par 5.2.1 et par le théorème 5.2 que H^0(U,G) et H^1_c(U,G) sont T-entiers'
note: Nothing is numbered 5.2 in the print (p. 385 has no paragraph number before Lemme 5.2.1); the T-integrality of H^1_c(U,G) is Théorème 5.2.2, cited as 5.2.2 on p. 386. Possibly the author's loose reference to the theorem of 5.2. The TeX keeps the printed reading.

where: 'et tel que G restreint à U soit constant tordu :' (before the diagram)
scan: restreint à U soit: U without prime (checked at 1.4x)
note: The clause defines U' (an open of U, dense in the smooth locus, on which G is constant tordu; G is only constructible on U); the diagram then has j' : U' -> X'. The TeX keeps the printed U.

where: first line: 'est T-entier. Désignnons par G_x le groupe de Galois'
note: Spelling slip of the typescript. The TeX keeps the printed reading.

scan: (resp (j_*G)_x^v): no full stop after resp (checked at 1.8x)
note: The same sentence prints '(resp. des coinvariants)'. The TeX keeps the printed reading.

where: 'sur V. On a I/I' ≃ Z_ell(1) (en tant que G/I-modules)'
scan: I/I' ≃ ℤ_ℓ(1): one mark between the two I's, the upper half of a slash (same slant, height and stroke width as the full slash of 'de I/I'' on the next line; its lower half is faint); no prime on the first I (pixel check)
note: The TeX adds a prime to the first I. I/I' is also the sense (I' the largest subgroup of I of order prime to ell; next line 'générateur topologique de I/I'').

where: 'pour chaque alpha, soit V^alpha le sous-espace propre généralisé de T'
scan: V^α without parentheses (checked at 1.3x); V^(α) further on in the sentence
note: Defined as V^α, then written V^(α) everywhere after (V = ⊕ V^(α), V^(1) ⊕ Σ V^(α), p. 390 V^(1)). The TeX keeps the printed reading.

where: Lemme 5.3.2, second line: 'rho I -> Gl(V) une représentation de I dans V'
scan: ρ  I ⟶ Gl(V): no colon after ρ (an empty gap; checked at 1.35x)
note: The colon of rho : I -> Gl(V) is missing. The TeX keeps the printed reading.

where: 'Il suffit de vérifier 3.2 lorsque V correspond'
note: The paragraph proves Lemme 5.3.2 (called 'Le sorite 5.3.2' below); 3.2 of this exposé is the unrelated Proposition 3.2. The TeX keeps the printed reading.
